import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd();
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5)); ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,5.5,'Solar cold store - layout',ha='center',fontsize=14)
# cold room
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,1),4,3,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(3,3.2,'cold room\n1 tonne\n4-6C',ha='center')
ax.text(3,1.3,'100mm PU insulation',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# door
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.2,1.5),0.8,1.5,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(5.5,2.2,'door',fontsize=8)
# PV roof
xs=[1,3,5,2.5]; ys=[4,5.2,5.2,4]; ax.plot([1,3,5,3],[4,5.2,5.2,4],lw=2); ax.text(3.2,4.7,'PV array tilted',fontsize=8)
# battery + controller
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((6.5,1),2.5,1.2,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(7.75,1.6,'LiFePO4 battery\n48V',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((6.5,2.7),2.5,0.8,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(7.75,3.1,'MPPT + DC cooler',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.arrow(4.5,4.5,1.5,-0.7,lw=1.5); ax.text(5.6,4.3,'DC cable',fontsize=8)
ax.arrow(6.5,1.8, -1.2,0.5,lw=1.5); ax.text(5.2,2.7,'cool air',fontsize=8)
ax.text(1,0.4,'fixed: room+PV rack  moving: air+refrigerant',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120); plt.close()
